title: Identical electrical reset can conceal different local outcomes
statement: In the introduced series model, a 9-ohm wound and 1-ohm intact lead exchange physical locations while carrying 0.5 A. Each independent thermal node has C=0.25 J/K, G=0.01 W/K and ambient 25 C. Both circuits have identical 5 V/0.5 A histories, open at 37.6019349 s and consume 94.0048373 J, but the wound reaches 200 C or 44.4444 C. The introduced closure law gives 0.9993557 versus zero, not measured polymer repair. This is a terminal-only counterexample under stated assumptions.

evidence.range_scope: Whole supplied ROOT local heating and functional-recovery derivations; no new Capital proof audit, source-original recovery or hidden-activity inference.

requires: Locate the actual damaged region, retain or isolate mechanical/fluid loads, direct heat without destroying healthy monitoring, recover a bounded cool state and verify useful function and critical stocks. The circuit model assumes two series ohmic elements, fixed current and independent lumped thermal nodes. The gas model assumes ideal air, a declared orifice law, finite isolated stock and known temperature/volume evolution. Apart from the source 0.5 A reference, these values are introduced rather than measured material, sensor or actuator properties.

assumptions: The terminal-only counterexample depends on its stated ohmic and thermal assumptions. Optional taps require actual surviving wiring and calibration; local power still does not prove repair. The closure law is not measured polymer kinetics and cooldown is not a prescribed readiness limit. Surrogate holes are not calibrated cracks. Real creep, force, fatigue, adhesion and stock renewal remain unresolved. The existing source already combines detection, heating, sealing and electrical reset. No new material, sensor algorithm, working device, whole-cost advantage or all-sensor obstruction is established.

The original note stays private; the public copy changes only two asset locators. ROOT reports independent derivation/execution. Its actual Krings main manufacturing/validation read scope is retained; figures were not visually inspected and videos/SI/cited originals were not followed. Legrand failed on first access; Guo later access failed without erasing earlier bounded exposure. Every prior source/access/transfer hold persists. No scientific replay, acquisition, experiment, hardware or resource expansion.

obstruction: Construct damage-region observability and a complete repair, cooling and load-return operation, with surviving monitoring, calibrated material/gas/thermal behavior, disposition of consumed conductive stock and useful-function/life evidence. A refreshed layer or replacement cartridge remains paid input; disappearance of a short or an isolated pressure observation does not close functional restoration.
